title: COP31 teeters on the brink as fossil fuel rift deepens
description: The fate of the COP31 climate summit hung by a thread on Sunday after a last-ditch bid to break a standoff over fossil fuels cast doubts over whether nations could clinch a deal.

title: Race to save climate talks as Cop31 risks collapse in fossil fuels row
Cop31 deal in jeopardy as latest draft omits fossil fuels
description: Organisers concerned there may not be enough delegates left in the room to pass the draft on Sunday

title: COP31 faces deadlock: Final draft omits reference to ‘fossil fuels’ and ‘phase out’
description: Negotiators at COP31 miss deadline as final draft omits explicit calls to phase out fossil fuels.

title: Six UK Wellness Experiences Embracing Nature and Ancient Practices
description: Discover six unique wellness retreats across the UK that move beyond traditional spa treatments to offer holistic experiences combining natural therapies, ancient rituals, and cutting-edge science, such as the herbal treatments at The Newt in Somerset.
